timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,470–1,473 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly (weakened in USD terms) due to SK Hynix's 40 trillion won foreign-exchange conversion, pushing the rate down from 1,555 to 1,473 KRW/USD over recent days. This means you need fewer won to buy $2,000, making it relatively cheaper to convert right now compared to recent weeks.

TIP: Lock in this conversion now if possible, since the government is encouraging more corporate repatriation, which may sustain won strength in the near term—but monitor for any reversal if dollar strength resumes globally.
